question: Tell me about the POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} endpoint.
ground_truth: The POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} endpoint converts text into speech using a specified voice and returns audio. Path parameter: voice_id (required) - the voice to use. Query parameters: enable_logging (boolean), optimize_streaming_latency (integer 0-4), output_format (string with codec options like mp3_44100_128, pcm_16000, opus_48000_64). Request body (JSON): text (required), model_id, language_code, voice_settings (stability, similarity_boost, style, speed, use_speaker_boost), pronunciation_dictionary_locators, seed, previous_text, next_text, previous_request_ids, next_request_ids, use_pvc_as_ivc, apply_text_normalization. Response: 200 returns binary audio (application/octet-stream), 422 returns validation error. Authentication via xi-api-key header.

correctness: Must mention the endpoint path and method
Must mention voice_id as path parameter
Must mention text as required body field
